findings.text: follow-on: GEQDSK_FIELDS treats COCOS as a peer accessor of the r/z/psirz grid arrays, so three of the 22 signals read a convention integer rather than a flux grid; the Done-when asks only that the G-EQDSK field signals exist, so the scalar signals are faithful but inflate the 22 count by three.

follow-on: _equilibrium_signals sets data_source_name to the uppercase 'EQDB'/'G-EQDSK', whereas the FacilitySignal field is elsewhere the lowercase parent-source name ('ppf', 'device_xml'); the value doubles as the check() discriminator, so a future normalisation of data-source names must keep both sites in step.

follow-on: the five exemplar records pin absolute host paths and SHA-256 digests, which is the intended dated-evidence design, but the run's own blocker notes two of the nine changed paths are absent from the live run pointer's node.write_paths, so the coordinator must widen the stopped run's scope before it can be promoted.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit d2803d75c..506ee3274 against the run's base 796f88e and against the parent merge fdf858318; the six commits add the two DataAccess methods and 22 signals, the shared reader module, the facility exemplar block with pinned hashes, the 304-line test file and the run's evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the Done-when requires both DataAccess nodes with root/shot/time templates, the EQDB and G-EQDSK field signals keyed by code, and one template read of an inventory exemplar per format returning the expected grid size with the command and exit recorded; all three are present (edas.py:52-152; 22 signals; template-reads.log EQ31 129x129 and G-EQDSK 60x129, EXIT=0).
item_verdicts.goal: section 46 asks for two DataAccess methods (EQDB-record local read and G-EQDSK file read) parameterised by root, shot and time, FacilitySignals per format's fields keyed by code in the signal scanner's existing EQDB path, and one template read of a section-45 exemplar per format with the command and exit recorded; imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:52-152 and :96-152 deliver the access methods and 22 signals, and the fragment records the reads.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records a gate with absolute paths and EXIT=0 (41 passed), an after_suite for revision 506ee3274 (completed true, failure_count 0, failure_ids []), a negative control, and the template/hash/exemplar logs; baseline_suite is empty, so no numeric baseline delta is available and this review derives added_failure_count from the zero-failure head arm.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest declares nine changed paths and the run's own six commits (fdf858318..506ee3274) touch exactly those nine, with nothing outside them in this node's diff; two of the nine (read_equilibrium_file.py, check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py) are absent from the live run pointer's node.write_paths, which is why check-manifest refuses promotion, and that is a coordinator scope-bookkeeping gap rather than a node scope violation.

justifications.durability: the exemplar SHA-256 values are pinned in jt-60sa.yaml and check() refuses a changed file (test_equilibrium_check_refuses_changed_example_bytes expects error 'equilibrium file hash differs from example'); the negative control shows the EQDB template guard actually fires (EXIT=1, shot 0 versus 101163) while the committed-head gate passes 41, and this reviewer reproduced that pass. The reservation is that the absolute exemplar paths and the dbsvr17p route are environment-dependent, so the anchored-hash check detects a moved or overwritten file only while the host paths persist.
justifications.evidence: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-discovery-completion/file-equilibria-access.html records the five-producer exemplar table (path, shot, time, grid, SHA-256), the per-format read result and the read command with its exit status; the run directory holds template-reads.log (EQ31 129x129 and G-EQDSK 60x129, EXIT=0), all-code-hash-check.log (valid 22 total 22, EXIT=0), exemplar-hashes.log pinning the five digests, and negative-control.log showing the EQDB shot mutation fails test_eqdb_local_template_uses_requested_shot_and_time with EXIT=1. This reviewer independently re-ran the same gate at 506ee3274 and reproduced 41 passed with EXIT=0 (reviewer-gate.log), though the two exemplar template reads were executed at 9a1b81c, before the final two commits.
justifications.fit: the new module imas_codex/remote/scripts/read_equilibrium_file.py is named for the capability it provides, _equilibrium_access_methods and _equilibrium_signals are private helpers beside the existing EDAS scanner logic, and ScanResult.data_accesses extends the existing dataclass (base.py:59) rather than introducing a parallel type. No symbol, filename, comment or commit subject carries a plan, phase, sprint or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:52 defines _equilibrium_access_methods returning two DataAccess nodes (jt-60sa:eqdb:local_record and jt-60sa:equilibrium:g_eqdsk_file); the templates are parameterised by root, shot and time (and filename_template for G-EQDSK), and _equilibrium_signals (edas.py:96) creates 22 code-keyed FacilitySignals keyed to SELENE/TOPICS (EQDB #GEO/RG,ZG,NSR,NSZ and #EQU/PSI) and SA/LIUQE/CHEASE (G-EQDSK r,z,psirz and COCOS); scan() attaches them at edas.py:430 and jt-60sa.yaml equilibrium_examples carries every inventory record, so all Deliverable and Done-when items are present, reserving only that COCOS travels as a peer signal to the psirz array and the compiled client's network mode to dbsvr17p is described but never exercised.
justifications.reuse: read_equilibrium_file.py holds one stdlib reader shared by the DataAccess templates and scripts/check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py, which now imports read_grid instead of keeping a second parser (that file shrank by about 185 lines); the change extends the existing EDAS scanner and ScanResult rather than forking a scanner, and persist_data_access is reused for every access node through one deduplicated loop at parallel.py:2861.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only fdf858318..506ee3274 lists exactly the nine paths the reviewed manifest declares (edas.py, base.py, parallel.py, enumerate_edas.py, read_equilibrium_file.py, check_jt60sa_flux_maps.py, test_edas_scanner.py, jt-60sa.yaml and the evidence fragment); the wider 796f88e..506ee3274 range additionally shows flux-map-inventory.html, flux-map-inventory.json, the selene-e101163 SVG, the plan HTML and a flux-map-run state JSON, all of which belong to the parent section-45 run merged at fdf858318 rather than to this node.
